Put files in it, gather more from other folders, and drag them out later, all together or one by one. Putting files in and dragging them out never moves the originals; dragging into a folder copies.
拖动文件时，把一行里选中的键一起按下再松开，那个轮盘就会在鼠标处弹出。转换轮盘把: While dragging files, press the keys picked in a row together and let go, and that wheel opens at the pointer. The Convert wheel turns files into other formats; the Tools wheel compresses, shrinks, splits or extracts audio; the Actions wheel copies paths, renames, compresses or deletes. The Tools and Actions wheels never open while no keys are picked for them.
